title: QR label generation — server-side SVG/PNG with deep link
objective: Verify GET /assets/:uuid/label returns a QR code (SVG/PNG) encoding the asset tag and the /scan?tag= deep link, per D-14.
steps: Request label; verify content type and non-empty body.
Decode QR payload (test-side decode or inspect generated content/embedded text).
Verify payload contains the asset tag and the /scan?tag=<tag> deep-link URL.
expected_result: 200 with image content; QR decodes to tag + correct deep link; label spec (50×25mm) noted for print CSS; endpoint permission-gated (401 anonymous, 404 out-of-scope).
automation_status: automatable (API/decode); print layout blocked without browser

title: Batch label printing
objective: Verify batch label generation for a filtered asset set produces labels for exactly the permitted, filtered assets.
preconditions: multiple in-scope assets + at least one out-of-scope asset.
test_data: batch label request (endpoint per delivered contract; e.g., POST /assets/labels or query param set)
steps: Request batch labels for a filter set.
Verify count and identity of included assets.
expected_result: Batch contains exactly the requested in-scope assets; out-of-scope excluded; permission-gated. If batch printing is deferred to C3, record deferral and mark BLOCKED.

title: Scan lookup — known tag opens asset
objective: Verify /scan?tag=<known tag> resolves to the correct asset detail (or lookup result) for authorized users.
preconditions: browser + running stack (BLOCKED if unavailable); known tag.
test_data: valid tag; tag of out-of-scope asset
steps: Navigate to /scan?tag=<tag> as operator; verify asset detail/lookup opens with correct asset.
Repeat with out-of-scope asset tag; verify no existence leak.
expected_result: Known in-scope tag lands on the asset; out-of-scope tag yields the same 'not found' UX as unknown tags; deep link requires auth first and returns to target after login.

title: Unknown/invalid code — clear non-destructive result
objective: Verify scanning/entering an unknown or malformed tag shows a clear 'not found' state and changes nothing.
preconditions: scan page or lookup endpoint; operator session.
steps: Submit unknown tag via manual entry (or lookup API).
Verify response/UX and that no state changed (asset counts, audit).
expected_result: Clear non-destructive 'not found' result; dangerous input handled inertly (escaped/rejected, never executed); no 500s; nothing persisted.
automation_status: API portion automatable; UI portion blocked without browser

title: Manual tag entry always available and keyboard operable
objective: Verify the scan page offers manual entry as a first-class fallback (no camera required), fully keyboard/screen-reader operable.
steps: Verify manual entry presented; complete a lookup keyboard-only.
expected_result: Manual entry visible without camera; labeled input; result announced via live region; no camera dependency for core flow.
